proof: For any Grand-Number assignment on the one-copy C(49,5) main-space cover, ordinary-draw portfolio average is invariant at C$2,428,660 under a player-favorable no-sharing prize model. Minimum legal draw-state gross cannot exceed this average. Even granting all three C$500,000 Bonus Draw liabilities without sharing gives only C$3,928,660 against C$5,720,652 cost.
